# cloudxino_kubernetes_cluster (Resource)

A CKS (CloudXino Kubernetes Service) cluster: a managed control plane and one node pool of workers on the team's private network. Billed per hour (control plane and nodes) from the team's wallet until destroyed; LoadBalancer Services are billed on their own.

Creating one usually takes about 5 minutes. `kubeconfig` holds the cluster's admin credentials and is kept in the Terraform state: protect the state accordingly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A CKS cluster with two worker nodes. Changing node_count resizes the default node pool in place.
resource "cloudxino_kubernetes_cluster" "prod" {
  name       = "prod"
  node_size  = "k8s-2vcpu-4gb"
  node_count = 2

  timeouts = {
    create = "40m"
  }
}

# Admin credentials for kubectl; kept in the Terraform state.
output "kubeconfig" {
  value     = cloudxino_kubernetes_cluster.prod.kubeconfig
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) 1-63 letters, digits or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit. Changing it renames the cluster in place.
- `node_size` (String) Worker size slug of the default node pool, e.g. `k8s-2vcpu-4gb` (the console's create page lists them). Changing it replaces the cluster.

### Optional

- `ingress` (Boolean) Install Traefik as the cluster's one LoadBalancer (default `true`); `false` = bring your own. Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `node_count` (Number) Nodes in the default node pool (default 2; the team's per-cluster limit applies). Changing it resizes the pool in place.
- `project_id` (String) Left out = the team's default project. Changing it moves the cluster.
- `region` (String) Region ID; left out = the default region. Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `version` (String) Kubernetes version, e.g. `1.36.5`; left out = the newest offered. Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `vpc_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `endpoint` (String) The Kubernetes API address for kubectl, `https://<host>:<port>`.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Admin kubeconfig (YAML), read while the cluster is active. Kept in state; read again on every refresh and update.
- `node_pool_id` (String) ID of the default node pool.
- `status` (String) `pending`, `provisioning`, `active`, `updating`, `deleting` or `error`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import cloudxino_kubernetes_cluster.prod <cluster_id>
```
